verdict.rationale: Unity documents launching the Editor from the command line to automate workflows. A probe notes the Editor's -batchmode/-nographics CLI is documented for headless CI builds. The Unity CLI and Build Automation are both positioned for CI and build agents. However, the evidence never shows the actual command-line build or export invocation, so the core build step is only implied. The community license-cost complaint is about price, not capability. missing for 10: first-party documentation of the command-line build/export invocation (e.g. a build method or target flags), explicit Editor batchmode/no-graphics doc quotes rather than a probe summary, independent hands-on corroboration of headless CI builds

support.subject: As a game developer, I can build and export the project from the command line, headless, in CI — no human clicking an editor
